Sample Matrix.csv.role: response-independent annual survey availability/count matrix confirmed by physical header

Sample Data.csv.role: response-independent survey effort/environment table confirmed by physical header

geometry_semantics_frozen_after_gate0_be.closed_registry: all 52 rows of Site Locations.csv; no future filtering by survey availability or biological response

sampling_row_semantics_frozen_before_gat.sample_matrix_count_rule: every 2010-2018 SampleCount token must be a non-empty base-10 non-negative integer; blank or non-integer stops rather than being interpreted as zero
sampling_row_semantics_frozen_before_gat.sample_matrix_site_rule: every Site_Number must belong to the frozen 52-site registry and duplicate Site_Number rows stop
sampling_row_semantics_frozen_before_gat.sample_data_duplicate_header_rule: duplicate Start_Time/End_Time names are preserved by position; no semantic meaning is assigned to suffix 1 versus 2 at Gate1
sampling_row_semantics_frozen_before_gat.sample_data_site_rule: non-empty Site_Number must belong to the frozen 52-site registry; no biological-response fields are permitted by the frozen physical header
sampling_row_semantics_frozen_before_gat.sample_data_date_rule: date must match one of YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY/MM/DD, M/D/YYYY, or M/D/YY; two-digit years map to 2000-2099; any other non-empty date token stops

focal_species.rule: must be selected later by an external response-independent rule; response prevalence/event counts are forbidden

next_gate: Gate1 may open only Site Locations.csv, Sample Matrix.csv and Sample Data.csv; compute 52-site structural ladder and response-independent annual sampling summaries while biological response assets remain unopened
